description: Pinned corrections to Natural Earth, applied by the maps build. Each entry carries its reason and evidence; see docs/superpowers/results/2026-09-27-map-edge-review-results.md. Collapsed borders: NE touches at a point, Wikidata P47 lists the pair, and geoBoundaries shows >= 1 km of border (the Four Corners noise floor is 0.6 km; the threshold was 5 km before 2026-09-30). collapsed_quadripoint / collapsed_point_contact (added 2026-10-02): NE touches at a point (for a quadripoint, one diagonal of a four-way point) and the rule above can't decide, but a reviewed Wikipedia neighbour list names the pair and nothing contradicts it; see review/pc_review_2026-10-02.json.
